_note: Body plans with full Dwarf Fortress anatomy (v0.013; generated by tools/gen_anatomy.js - edit there). relsize = DF relative size (HUMANOID_RELSIZES / BP defaults): the dumb target roll weighs every non-internal part by it (fingers 5, teeth 1, eyes 5). Layers are outside-in; t is mm at a 70 kg body, scaled by (body mass/70)^(1/3). tissue is the class the code knows (skin fat muscle bone organ brain nerve tendon); mat is the DF material (materials.json) when it differs; pain and vasc are the DF tissue template's PAIN_RECEPTORS and VASCULAR (only where they differ from the skin/fat/muscle/bone table). internal: an inner part (DF INTERNAL) reached only through its parent: a blow that gets through the parent's layers goes on into one inner part picked by relsize; around: the blow passes that part first (DF SKULL AROUND BRAIN 100). connector: severing the parent needs this cut through too (DF CONNECTOR: upper spine, skull). socket: knocked out when broken (teeth). under_pressure: spills when the parent's wall is cut open (guts). nerves: DF HAS_NERVES: cutting through the muscle severs the motor and sensory nerves. digit: a finger of that hand (grip). armor_as: armour over the part named covers this one too. spine: the spinal cord's level. Tendons are ours (DF has none). Thickness of new parts [ours]: K x cube root of the DF part volume, K fitted to the organ thicknesses the game had (tools/gen_anatomy.js).

quadruped._note: DF QUADRUPED-style plan for wolves, bears and boars (creatures.json drop_parts trims toes per beast: DF wolf 4 toes, bear 5, boar hooves). Outer legs keep the game's front/rear upper, lower, paw split.
